blake3.oracle: pinned pure Python compression/tree reference; no FFI

hkdf_sha256.oracle: PyCA cryptography / OpenSSL HMAC/SHA256, manual extract/expand checked against OpenSSL-backed HKDF

rfs1.oracle: standalone manual Python struct encoder and separate bounds scanner

jcs.oracle: manual Python RFC8785 restricted safe-integer serializer, UTF16 key sort; floats rejected

register_control_capture.method: One-shot standalone rustc capture outside checkout. Helper function bodies canonical_json_bytes, encode_base64url, framed_hash, signing_bytes and custody_action_hash extracted verbatim with git show at baseline; exact tagged CustodyProofAction declaration retained. Unused Publish/HomeMigration payload aliases are JSON Value; error alias is boxed Error. Register payload remains its original Value. Existing cached dependency rlibs used, no Cargo invocation or product consumer added. Ed25519-dalek signs the pinned JCS proof transcript. All four byte/hash/signature assertions match independently computed Python control. DeviceRef, BindingMode and BranchProofV3 declarations are also extracted from the pin; proof serialization uses the typed body, not a JSON Value.
register_control_capture.result: REGISTER_BASELINE PASS: pinned JCS/action hash/proof transcript/Dalek signature match
